reassessment.prompt: In S of 11 outcomes, |A|=3, |B|=7 and |A∩B|=1. A learner claims P(A or B)=10/11 by adding P(A)+P(B). Find the first error and correct probability.
options: No error; P(A or B)=10/11
Overlap counted twice; P(A or B)=9/11
Overlap counted twice; P(A or B)=10/11
Events are complementary; P(A or B)=1
